name: kmem
description: /dev/mem and /dev/kmem, 2.11BSD pdp/mem.c mmrw minors 0 and 1 (here both the 24-bit physical address the offset names), nlist(3) on /netnix, the network stack's name list the build writes, and sysctl kern.netdata, where the stack's data bank is: route(8)'s flushroutes reads the routing hash through exactly these.  The probe reads the stack's rthashsize (8) at netdata plus its /netnix offset, is refused the I/O window with EFAULT, writes and reads back a byte of its own through /dev/mem, and as uid 1 is refused /dev/kmem (0640 root:kmem).
